about.title: About Me
about.imageAlt: Portrait of Gonzalo Lobos, E-commerce and Web Development Specialist
about.introduction:
I am a Business Engineer specializing in E-commerce, Paid Media, and Frontend Development.
I bridge financial vision and return on investment with hands-on technical execution: I plan and optimize acquisition campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads directed at ultra-fast landing pages and online stores engineered for frictionless checkout conversion.
I bring over 4 years of corporate experience at Nespresso leading high-demand commercial operations (Cyber Days and Black Friday), conversion audits with GA4, and technical SEO.
Today, as Founder of Expansis Pro, I also integrate applied AI workflows and WhatsApp API to respond to, qualify, and schedule incoming prospects in seconds, preventing paid leads from going cold.
about.callToAction: I am looking to work with innovative teams focused on digital growth. If you are seeking a technical profile with a business mindset and AI expertise, let's connect.
